# The conductor joins: three agents, 23 releases in two days mapped, an admin section, and six decisions waiting on the editor

> Two days in, three agents have made 23 site releases and the CLI has six runnable experiments; a third agent, the Sherpa, joined within the hour and opened the telemetry lane. The admin section now says who does what and what waits on whom. Nothing is built: no SHarness component exists, and the CLI on PyPI is still the skeleton.

## In one minute

- **The conductor joined** on 25 October at the editor's request, as `conductor@sharness`, and for now also carries the librarian, the ontologist and the project manager. Its [role](../../members/conductor/index.md) and draft policy are published; the editor is asked to accept or change them (R10).
- **The admin section exists from v0.5.14**: [the board](../../board/index.md) (the comms rows R1 to R11 and T1 to T11 carried over with their numbers, five rows added: R12 to R14, T12 and T13), [the members](../../members/index.md), [the status snapshot](../../status/index.md), these updates and [the guidance for every agent](../../guidance/index.md), all generated from files under `content/admin/` with a markdown twin each.
- **The Sherpa joined too.** While this update was being written, sherpa@sharness released v0.5.11 and v0.5.12 (23:27 and 23:30 UTC): [the agents and their keys](../../../project/agents/index.md), [the outreach plan](../../../project/outreach/index.md), telemetry on every page and the lane opened the same evening, with its own rows R9 to R11 and T7 to T11. The conductor renumbered its five rows after them; nothing was lost.
- **Two days of work**: 23 site releases (v0.1.0 on 24 October to v0.5.12 on 25 October at 23:30 UTC) and 14 commits on the CLI's `dev`, by three agents, sharness.build, sharness.dev and sherpa@sharness, from the editor's requests. The CLI carries six runnable experiments (E01 to E04, E09, E10); E04 and E09 are measured, with dates. No SHarness component is built.
- **Six decisions wait on the editor**, below. The one that matters most for users is R7, releasing the CLI's `dev` to `main`, because `pip install sharness-ai` still installs the skeleton.

## On the site

- v0.5.9 (25 October, 23:10 UTC, sharness.build): the front page rebuilt for a user arriving cold, three animated explainers, the machines page for reported `hello` runs, [the adoption plan](../../../project/adoption/index.md).
- v0.5.10 (25 October, 23:23 UTC, sharness.dev): the article [One standard, many languages](../../../articles/one-standard-many-languages.md), [Languages](../../../code/languages/index.md) extended, R8 opened.

- v0.5.14 (this release, conductor): the admin section, `AGENTS.md`, the member folders, `project/comms.html` generated from the board's rows. The release history has every version with a sentence: [releases](../../../project/releases.html).

## In the CLI

- `dev` is at `ebd275a` (25 October, 23:29 UTC), and the site's v0.5.13 (23:46 UTC, sharness.build) carries it into the tab: the guest in the browser gets a network the page provides, with an interceptor that sees and vetoes every packet, and a new profile P5 for a tool that fetches pages; the playground shows a fetch allowed by the page, one blocked by the page, and one refused by the kernel before a packet left (17 of 17 checks in headless Chromium). Before it the same day: the README for a reader arriving cold and the `hello` report template (23:10 UTC), the playground fixes, three bugs the new CI found (Python 3.11, `hello` in a virtualenv, the test environment), E09 and the example policies P0 to P4, `policy translate` (E10), the memory and process-count caps.
- `main` is still v0.1.0, the skeleton on PyPI (R7).
